method: New tasks on reused authorized synthetic fixtures; source-derived independently checkable, assistant graded, not blinded. No unseen-world claim.

grading.full_task: All original outcomes, correct source scope/relationships and useful explanation; no serious unsupported claim
grading.advancement: +2 adequate versus matched control, no critical release/prohibited reads; preserve original formal thresholds

cases.prompt: Investigate the Harbor–Meadow UDP/5514 failure using relevant registered evidence. Explain the forward and return stopping points with their owners, compare saved and running artifacts, and investigate the purpose of the configuration reference. Distinguish the modeled blocker from an established physical cause.
expected_claims: Forward failure at Meadow Ethernet2/1 ingress, not Transit egress; return failure at Meadow Ethernet2/1 egress
Meadow admin up/oper down despite no shutdown
Saved/current artifact difference includes reference comment, not proven activation event time
Actual review-rx-729 purpose is receive-power-margin review before selecting replacement optic; no completed replacement/physical diagnosis
Relevant authorized source coverage and explicit source limitations
prohibited_claims: No incident merely because logs absent

cases.prompt: Consult recorded state only for Harbor Ethernet9/3 and Meadow Ethernet9/3. Compare owner, address, VRF and administrative/operational state. Does the equal address establish a conflict or successful communication? Do not read inventory, configurations, topology or logs.
expected_claims: Equal prefixes in separately recorded VRFs do not by themselves prove an address conflict or delivery; no physical collection or state inference from configuration
prohibited_claims: No incident merely because logs absent

cases.prompt: Using inventory and planned links only, explain the relationship between Harbor Ethernet1/2 and Transit Ethernet1/2. Include each interface owner, recorded prefix and VRF, and the documented peer. Explain what this establishes about operational connectivity.
prohibited_claims: Unread or unavailable logs establish no event
Source citations certify all causal prose
Capture times alone establish active change timing

cases.prompt: Examine the Transit Ethernet1/2 incident history. Compare available saved, earlier running and current running artifacts and the recorded applied-change event. Explain the observed forwarding consequence and which change times are established versus merely bounded by observations.
prohibited_claims: Unread or unavailable logs establish no event
Source citations certify all causal prose
Capture times alone establish active change timing

cases.prompt: Use configuration and syslog only. What recorded work purpose is associated with the reference in Meadow running configuration? Contrast what the saved and running artifacts contain and say whether the record proves that the work was completed.
expected_claims: Identify review-rx-729 from actual source record after justified supplemental read
Saved/current comment difference, without inferred applied time
Receive-power-margin review before selecting an optic; no completed repair
prohibited_claims: No incident merely because logs absent

cases.prompt: Read only Transit Ethernet1/2 recorded state. Report its prefix and distinguish administrative enablement from operational readiness. Do not query configuration, inventory, logs or topology.
prohibited_claims: Unread or unavailable logs establish no event
Source citations certify all causal prose
Capture times alone establish active change timing
